body:
[aida:reviewer] #1984 REVIEWED — REQUEST-CHANGES at 2096f9c17e68, and the provenance gap
is closed. 1 of 4 done; moving to #2039 next.

THE PRIOR REFUSAL STANDS IN FULL, and I verified every finding against the artifact at
this head rather than inheriting them:

  acceptance 2   the two Codex Degraded cells STILL cite TASK-1279 — the spec this PR
                 completes. Lines 14 and 18 of docs/agents/seat-parity.md. Every
                 Antigravity Degraded cell three lines away cites TASK-1207 correctly.
  acceptance 4   the document refuses itself: "Do not claim completion until the first
                 wave has merged at least one drain-mode spec behind the Codex advisor
                 gate." Neither wave has run.
  the mechanism  spec reads Done, commit carries the (TASK-1279) trailer, so the merge
                 auto-bumps to Completed and criterion 4 plus both gaps in acceptance 2
                 stop being readable at the moment this lands.
  acceptance 1   FOUR pasted probes against ~24 non-N/A cells, and two of the four are
                 --help invocations. --help proves the flag parses, not that the seat
                 works.

PROVENANCE: recorded against 2096f9c17e68 on task-1279. The prior verdict had no sha, so
nothing could say whether it applied to the current head. That is now fixed for this PR
whatever happens to the findings — one of the five no-sha rows discharged.

WHAT I ADDED, AND IT IS A PATH TO A MERGE RATHER THAN ANOTHER ROUND. THE CODE IS CLEAN
AND SEPARABLE. Two files: 47 added lines in advisor_watch.rs, and an 82-line new
document. EVERY finding is about the document or the spec status. None is about the
implementation — the prior reviewer recorded acceptance 3 as met and I agree on reading
it: a non-Claude resolved vendor routes to cold_boot_and_run with AgentSeat::Advisor, so
per-seat model and effort selection still applies.

So the blocker is not the code. It is that the PR bundles a COMPLETION CLAIM with a
working change. The smallest thing that makes it approvable is a scoping decision:

  1. file a successor for the two Codex fork-from-live gaps and repoint those cells at it
  2. correct the Evidence section to claim only what was run
  3. either scope criterion 4 out explicitly, or drop the trailer so the merge does not
     close the spec

That is yours, not mine. I am naming it so the next round is spent on a decision rather
than on rediscovering four findings that have not moved since 00:44Z.

NOTE ON THROUGHPUT: this is a refusal, which is the honest outcome, but it is not a dead
end. Items 1-3 are minutes of work by someone with the authority to make the scoping
call — no code, no CI cycle, no implementer round. If you make that call, the next head
is approvable on its face and I will say so quickly.

NEXT: #2039, then #2040, then #2019. I will report each as it lands rather than batching.
subject: #1984 REQUEST-CHANGES at 2096f9c17e68 — all four findings verified still live; but the CODE is clean and the blocker is a scoping decision you can make without an implementer round
